name: Vitamin D3 + K2
summary: Vitamin D3 + K2 combines vitamin D repletion with vitamin K-dependent calcium protein activation; sleep evidence is deficiency-dependent and mixed.
description: Vitamin D3 plus K2 pairs calcium-regulating signaling with vitamin K-dependent activation of proteins relevant to bone, vascular, and immune regulation.
safetyNotes: Excess vitamin D may cause hypercalcemia; K2 interacts with warfarin.
evidenceLevel: Editorial grade not demonstrated by recorded studies
contraindications: warfarin or another vitamin-K antagonist without clinician-directed anticoagulation monitoring.
evidence_tier: Editorial grade not demonstrated by recorded studies
